claim: Claim 6: FMoW satellite imagery, six regions (249 countries in training data), near-tight worst-case coverage with smaller sets than single-source methods (Sec. 6.1, Fig. 8)
reason: Reproduction requires the WILDS FMoW v1.1 dataset (>100 GB, >1M images) plus DenseNet-121 training for 30 epochs and prediction over 100 calibration/test splits (README steps 1-4). This is not attainable CPU-only inside the ~75-minute budget; no download was started.
what_was_verified_instead: nothing - deliberately NOT substituted by a synthetic toy, per the task's hard rule
